FROM MENTAL NOISE TO MOMENTUM

A lighter way to get going.

  1. Speak the messy version.

    Click the capture box and activate the shortcut configured in your Wispr Flow desktop app. Flow inserts your words into this field.

  2. Make it yours.

    Use one sentence per task. Say “urgent,” “tomorrow,” or “20 minutes.” Untangle, then review the suggested titles, dates, categories, and durations.

  3. Do one small thing.

    Open a task's focus session. Start the timer, take the next step, and mark it done. Export your plan whenever you like.

Unspool doesn't record audio or connect to Wispr Flow. Flow handles dictation separately. Your plan stays in this browser; export a backup to keep a copy.
YOUR SPACE, YOUR DATA

Keep your thoughts close.

Tasks and drafts are saved in this browser. They don't sync across devices. Clearing browser data removes your workspace.

Restore replaces this workspace after confirmation. Download a backup first if you want to keep the current plan.
